CICC 2026, presented April 2026. Fabricated 16 nm FinFET capacitive HBC transceiver; chip photograph and measurements in the author-hosted paper. TX 0.84 pJ/bit and RX 3.2 pJ/bit are taken separately from the paper abstract. The 2.2 pJ/b title figure is described in the presentation as a 50% TX / 50% RX operating assumption; it is NOT treated as simultaneous TX+RX link energy. The paper and slides contain differing RX power/energy breakdowns, so a full-link total is left blank pending reconciliation. 15 MHz carrier and -47 dBm sensitivity from the paper. A resonant TX driver does not imply magnetic body coupling.
